_source.lmsVerify: RFC 8554 Appendix F test cases 1 and 2 and RFC 9858 Appendix A test cases, as transcribed by Botan (src/tests/data/pubkey/hss_lms_verify.vec).
_source.lmotsKeygen: Botan src/tests/data/pubkey/lmots.vec, generated with cisco/hash-sigs. I, q and SEED are all given, so these exercise RFC 8554 Appendix A key generation and Algorithm 1 directly.
_source.xmssVerify: Botan src/tests/data/pubkey/xmss_verify.vec — one vector for each of the 21 parameter sets in the IANA XMSS registry.
_source.xmssKeygen: Botan src/tests/data/pubkey/xmss_keygen_reference.vec, generated from the XMSS reference implementation (XMSS/xmss-reference) that accompanies RFC 8391. These are what pin SP 800-208 section 6.2's PRF_keygen and the four-byte padding of the 192-bit sets.
_source.negatives: Botan src/tests/data/pubkey/xmss_invalid.vec and hss_lms_invalid.vec — signatures that MUST NOT verify.
_source.encoding: Every byte string here is BASE64, not hex. The sources publish hex; storing 21 XMSS parameter sets' worth of signatures that way put this file at a quarter of a megabyte, and the point of keeping all 21 is that the page offers all 21.
_source.xmssmt: GENERATED WITH THE XMSS REFERENCE IMPLEMENTATION — github.com/XMSS/xmss-reference at commit 171ccbd26f098542a67eb5d2b128281c80bd71a6, the code that accompanies RFC 8391 — because no XMSS^MT test vector is published anywhere: Botan does not implement it, the reference implementation ships no KAT files, and RFC 8391's appendices are XDR formats rather than examples. They are DETERMINISTIC and anybody can reproduce them: build that repository, call xmssmt_core_seed_keypair() with a 3n-byte seed of 0x00,0x01,0x02,..., then xmssmt_core_sign() over the message below, and read sk_seed, sk_prf, root and pub_seed out of the secret key at offsets index_bytes, +n, +2n and +3n. docs/hbs.md carries the procedure.

xmssNegative.why: Random byte swap in OTS signature.
Added 6 byte random prefix to signature.
